task.title: Monthly inspection of feed pump B
task.shortdesc: Preventive maintenance procedure. The technician on shift records four readings and closes the work order. Fictional sample written for this portfolio: it isn't an operating instruction for real equipment.

ul.li: The work order is assigned to your shift.
You have read the site safety rules for the pump room.
The pump is running at its normal load.

prereq.note: Stay outside the guard while the pump runs. Take every reading from a gauge or the console.

ul.li: The maintenance console on a tablet

step.cmd: Open the work order in the maintenance console, and then select Record readings.
Read the discharge pressure on the local gauge, and enter it in bar.
Read the bearing temperature on the console, and enter it in °C.
Measure the vibration on the bearing housing with the meter, and enter it in mm/s.
Look for leaks around the seal, and enter what you see.

result.p: The work order shows Ready to close, and all four results are inside their expected range. Select Close work order. If a result is outside its range, don't close the work order: report it to the shift supervisor.
